name: Marcus Reyes
title: Senior Financial Analyst
about: CFA charterholder and financial analyst with 8 years of experience in investment analysis, financial modelling, and corporate valuation across banking and asset management. I turn complex financial data into clear, actionable insights — helping institutions and executives make confident, high-stakes decisions.

details: Lead equity research coverage for 14 listed Philippine companies across consumer, property, and utilities sectors.
Built DCF, DDM, and comparable company models that informed ₱2.4B in institutional investment decisions.
Produce weekly market commentary and monthly sector reports distributed to 600+ institutional clients.
Mentor 3 junior analysts and co-lead the team's financial modelling training programme.
Conducted credit analysis and loan structuring for corporate clients with combined credit lines of ₱800M.
Developed an automated Excel-based financial spreading tool that reduced analysis turnaround by 35%.
Prepared board-level presentations on portfolio credit quality and risk exposure metrics.
Performed financial statement audits for clients in banking, real estate, and manufacturing sectors.
Led substantive testing procedures for revenue, receivables, and fixed assets portfolios.
Assisted in the preparation of SEC and BSP regulatory filings for two listed banking clients.
